title: gdalraster.windows 0.4.0
text: gdal_build_gdalraster() now stages installs fully self-contained gdalraster package. GDAL dependency DLLs vendored beside gdalraster.dll; matching GDAL/PROJ data pure-Python osgeo_utils vendored package. Added provenance manifests installed GDAL SDKs built gdalraster packages. Runtime installation idempotent, setup detects stale builds bundle update. Added porcelain API: gdal_setup(), gdal_update(), gdal_sitrep(), gdal_verify(), gdal_uninstall(). Added gdal_enable_python(), provisions managed system-CPython .pth file without setting PYTHONPATH. Removed activate_gdal_runtime(), load_gdal_dll(), load_gdalraster(), configure_gdal_home(), gdal_rprofile_snippet(), add_gdal_rprofile_hook(), install_gdal_runtime(), install_gdalraster(), verify_gdalraster_runtime(). old aliases. Removed load-time bootstrap, PATH mutation, DLL preloading, GDAL/PROJ environment exports, profile-hook machinery.

title: gdalraster.windows 0.4.0
text: Baseline runtime now GDAL v3.13.2 (gdal-v3.13.2). Apache Arrow / Parquet / Thrift built statically folded libgdal-*.dll. Shared libarrow*.dll, libparquet*.dll, libthrift*.dll banned published closure. Arrow’s mimalloc/jemalloc allocators disabled. removes MinGW emulated-TLS first-Parquet-open crash class import graph (#38). Bundle CI gates now include LoadLibrary smoke testing, shared-Arrow ban, gdal_verify(), TLS-noisy first Parquet open (httpuv/later + Rust cdylib) release publication. Published bundles embed MANIFEST.dcf provenance-aware installs.

title: gdalraster.windows 0.4.0

Parquet initialization workaround package. Arrow/TLS correction owned GDAL bundle build enforced first-open verification.

title: gdalraster.windows 0.4.0

title: gdalraster.windows 0.3.1
text: install_gdalraster() now checks working Rtools toolchain front (pkgbuild::has_build_tools()) aborts installation guidance none found, instead failing mid-compile raw make/gcc error. Rtools documented one prerequisite prebuilt runtime bundle eliminate — README, Getting Started vignette, install_gdalraster() help page (also gains Upgrading section: rebuild gdalraster every runtime bundle upgrade).

title: gdalraster.windows 0.3.1
text: Fixed bundle-wide LoadLibrary failure: dynamic link library (DLL) initialization routine failed (Windows error 1114) made published bundles unloadable machines without Rtools’ UCRT64 tree. Root cause: MSYS2 libpodofo.dll (PDF driver backend) fails DllMain-time OpenSSL initialization MSYS2 libcrypto-3-x64.dll. PDF driver now disabled outright (GDAL_ENABLE_DRIVER_PDF=plus poppler/podofo/pdfium backends). HDF5 NetCDF drivers enabled ; earlier theory OpenBLAS/Fortran dependency chain conflicts R’s DLLs disproven empirically (every DLL chain loads cleanly inside R). Bundle verification now three layers: dependency closure (ntldd walk plus banned-DLL guard PDF/NSS chains collect_dlls.sh), loadability (every bundled DLL LoadLibrary-tested CI asset can publish), functionality (e2e workflow runs every published bundle release).

title: gdalraster.windows 0.3.1
text: install_gdalraster() now replaces installed package’s gdal/ proj/ data directories runtime bundle’s share/gdal share/proj source install succeeds (#25). Upstream gdalraster’s Makevars.win populates directories Rtools static tree, builds compiled bundle GDAL previously shipped — activated via GDAL_DATA/proj_search_paths() — data files different GDAL/PROJ version. install_gdal_runtime(overwrite = TRUE) longer fails spurious “locked another process” error current session holds locks. auto-bootstrap preloads runtime package load prepends bin PATH, DLLs loaded later session resolve dependencies runtime directory module name — release download loads curl package, maps runtime’s zlib1.dll outside R’s DLL registry, dyn.unload() release . session therefore never delete runtime. Leftover mapped DLLs now moved aside stale sibling directory (<gdal_home>.stale-<pid>-<timestamp>) — Windows allows renaming, though deleting, mapped DLLs — install proceeds; stale directories deleted opportunistically later installs, installer advises R restart rebuilding loading gdalraster. install_gdal_runtime(tag = "latest") longer trusts GitHub’s single “latest release” pointer, broke default install path whenever R package release (v*, bundle asset) marked latest. “latest” now scans release list selects newest non-draft, non-prerelease release publishes runtime bundle asset matching asset_pattern, decoupling package release track GDAL bundle release track. GitHub API requests now authenticated token available — resolved git credential store (gitcreds), GITHUB_PAT GITHUB_TOKEN environment variables — avoiding anonymous rate limits CI behind shared networks. Release-asset selection also tolerates assets missing name field.

title: gdalraster.windows 0.3.0
text: vignettes migrated R Markdown (knitr::rmarkdown) Quarto (quarto::html); VignetteBuilder now quarto. New “Getting Started” vignette covering full install → build → load → verify workflow, everyday use, install locations overrides, offline installation. “Runtime Guide” rewritten around current API: gdal_home resolution order, session activation, auto-bootstrap options (gdalraster.windows.auto_bootstrap, gdalraster.windows.auto_load_gdalraster), source builds bundle, managed .Rprofile hooks, embedded-python algorithms, runtime upgrades. “Architecture” claims verified upstream sources (GDAL 3.12.2 registration fix, Rtools45 release 6768 muparser addition, PE/COFF export-ordinal limit); corrected bundle layout description — executables ship bundle (BUILD_APPS=). Extensive linking across README vignettes: toolchain components (MinGW-w64, MSYS2, UCRT64, Rtools45), GDAL/PROJ/driver references, upstream issues, build scripts. README package guide now points pkgdown-hosted articles. install_gdalraster() runtime guide document installing source build regular user library via existing lib argument (e.g. lib = .libPaths()[1]). Troubleshooting vignette covers dependency DLLs resolve CI user machines, runtime deletion blocked file locks.
